Full guest addresses resolve to those labels at 0x7001d2ee23, 0x7001ce2ddc, 0x7001d0058e, 0x7001cd0235, 0x7001ca7c70, 0x7001cc6156, and 0x7001d4b5d4. Body: decompiled/main/main_0157.c:675-749, 778-844, 871-920. Caller passes the parsed input/context: decompiled/main/main_0156.c:55542-55549.

The routine selects a live-roster mode, initializes the live roster file, checks the pack, reports corrupt/incomplete data, and completes roster compression. Full guest strings LIVE_ROSTERS (0x7001ce75a6), CLiveRosterEngine::ActivateRosterFile executing (%s) (0x7001cabdcf), roster_LIVE.dat (0x7001d4629c), failed to open Live Roster pack file (0x7001cfcc31), and Live Roster pack is corrupt or incomplete... (0x7001c63e89) are used along this path. Body: decompiled/main/main_0070.c:17842-17968. Callers: decompiled/main/main_0070.c:17164-17172, 17417-17424, 17736-17744.

The caller routes a client message/object and output context here (decompiled/main/main_0071.c:36000-36005). The body examines its message type, dispatches among distinct handlers, and emits handling for trophy, telemetry update, TC stash update, friend-list change, and asynchronous match-update cases. Full guest strings ClientInternalType (0x7001cf3677), trophy (0x7001c76c26), UpdateTcStash (0x7001d63528), and Got telemetry update request ... (0x7001cd4f19) are direct dispatch/log keys. Body: decompiled/main/main_0071.c:36085-36195, 36201-36230.

The routine checks PEM encryption header state, parses the cipher name and DEK-Info IV, reads/decodes hexadecimal IV bytes, and initializes cipher/decryption state. Its full-address source string is the OpenSSL pem_lib.c path at 0x7001d1ce1e; the body uses the DEK-Info header and hex-byte parser path. Body: decompiled/main/main_0155.c:9625-9697, 9700-9829, 9846-9896. Caller: decompiled/main/main_0155.c:9155-9162.

The body runs asynchronous file-read/status paths and handles failures for rosters.bin and stats.bin, then accesses Frontend\Stats\lockedaccessories.bin. Verified strings are Problem reading rosters.bin! at 0x7001cb6620, Problem reading stats.bin! at 0x7001cac50f, and Frontend\Stats\lockedaccessories.bin at 0x7001d46961. Body: decompiled/main/main_0076.c:20437-20558. No observed callers in the available caller index.

The body performs lookups using FILT_TYPE (0x7001d2b136), FILT_POS (0x7001ccb7fb), and FILT_ROLE (0x7001c91de6), then selects among several branches. The key names and body alone do not establish the routine's higher-level purpose or the meaning of its input flags. Body: decompiled/main/main_0078.c:24154-24248; no observed callers.

The body queries a property map for DATA_CR, challenge, and ENEMY_TYPE, then branches on a compact selector table and checks associated stadiums, opponents, mini_bosses, and zone_sweepers values before setting the corresponding properties. Full addresses include DATA_CR 0x7001cac932, challenge 0x7001d2ad87, ENEMY_TYPE 0x7001ccb91f, stadiums 0x7001d4f535, opponents 0x7001c8924b, mini_bosses 0x7001cdf462, and zone_sweepers 0x7001ce9d03. Body: decompiled/main/main_0079.c:37272-37363. No observed callers in the available caller index.
